capabilities: Sync vault files to a Google Drive folder on demand
Keep both versions of a conflicting note, the other saved with a timestamped name
Resume an interrupted sync without creating duplicates
Log the last 500 sync actions to a log file
Store the OAuth client secret and refresh token in Obsidian's secret storage
disambiguation: Not a general drive or device sync tool; it copies vault files to a folder in Google Drive only.
extras: You must create your own Google Cloud OAuth client and refresh token; while the consent screen is in Testing, Google expires refresh tokens after 7 days. Deletions, renames and empty folders are not synced, and the README advises backing up the vault before the first sync. Real-world testing is ongoing.
problem: There is no built-in way to keep a vault in step with a folder in Google Drive, and an interrupted or conflicting sync can leave notes out of date or overwritten.

relations.evidence: Sync an Obsidian vault with a folder in your Google Drive using one command, Sync.

requires.name: Google Cloud OAuth client ID and client secret

summary: Command that syncs vault files with a folder in the user's own Google Drive, keeping both copies when a note changed on two devices.
